result.topic_en: A fragment of a divergence-form second-order differential expression: the derivative with respect to x_1 of a linear combination of the first partial derivatives of u, plus a small sketched diagram.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial \left( a_{1,1} [-\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-] \frac{\partial u}{\partial x_1} + a_{1,2} \frac{\partial u}{\partial x_2} + a_{1,3} \frac{\partial u}{\partial x_3} \right)}{\partial x_1} + \cdot$

[sketch: a horizontal line with a vertical line descending from it, dots placed above and below the horizontal line]

methods.what: First term of a second-order linear differential operator in divergence form with coefficients a_{ij} in three variables
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial \left( a_{1,1} [-\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-] \frac{\partial u}{\partial x_1} + a_{1,2} \frac{\partial u}{\partial x_2} + a_{1,3} \frac{\partial u}{\partial x_3} \right)}{\partial x_1} + \cdot$
